purpose: Fields required before an image can leave UNVERIFIED and receive an admitted authentic or counterfeit label.

authenticity_evidence.authentic: The source identifies the physical watch or the capturing organization, and the verifier records why the item is authentic.
authenticity_evidence.counterfeit: The source identifies the item, and the verifier records why the item is counterfeit.

admitted_record.brand_evidence: A brand value stored separately from the folder name, with the basis recorded. A readable wordmark may be cited as supporting observation. It is not sufficient alone.

if_evidence_is_missing: Keep provenance_status UNVERIFIED. Do not assign either class.
review_status: REQUIRES_EXPERT_REVIEW is for placeholders, collages, component-only images, cross-brand copies, and visual disputes. It is not an admitted label.
